items.title: An invertible module on a proper integral algebraic space with sections of it and of its dual is trivial

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an invertible module on a proper integral algebraic space over a field which has a nonzero section and whose dual has a nonzero section is trivial (statement lines 2724-2730). The proof (proof lines 2732-2749) shows that nonzero sections of the module and of its dual are nonzero at the generic point by trivializing on affine etale neighbourhoods, concludes that their product is a nonzero global function, and uses that the ring of global functions is a field to deduce that the product is nowhere zero and the module trivial. H2: a three-step argument with three inputs, written out in full.
